title: Path Manager
text: Compute and execute a UAV autonomous mission, 5 inputs, 1 output; {UAV type} sets the type of UAV, {Loiter radius}, {Data type} and {Mission bus name} sets the name of input mission bus. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Pose
ports.summary: Current UAV pose four-element column vector

ports.name: IsModeDone
ports.summary: Determine if mission point was executed 0 (default) | 1

ports.name: MissionCmd
ports.summary: Command to change mission uint8(0) (default) | 8-bit unsigned integer between 0 and 3

ports.name: Home
ports.summary: UAV home location three-element column vector

params.name: Loiter radius
params.values: Loiter radius for fixed-wing UAV 25 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of input mission bus double (default) | single
